source: Exact image inspection plus previous owner eating/greeting confirmation; no gaze/intent reference

cases.challenge-food: Food in hand below mouth; eating context
cases.challenge-remote: Seated hands below frame; no visible held remote
cases.challenge-screen: Seated leaning forward, head/gaze down; target unseen
cases.heldout-b-rest: Seated head slightly down; hands outside frame
cases.heldout-b-down: Seated facing approximately forward; hands outside frame
cases.heldout-food: Food in raised hand; eating context

grading: Count useful task-state categories and unsupported specific claims per unique frame, not repeated executions. Screen attention/held remote/tie claims require visible support. Static posture alone does not count as food or raised-hand recognition.
